text: {"lessons":["I sold Stocks B and C after gains, then bought them back later; avoid letting a gain over my cost basis alone determine when to sell.","I sold Stock A for a small gain and later repurchased it at a lower price; make each decision based on future prospects rather than anchoring on my entry price.","My account value fell for several periods, then recovered somewhat without any trades; short-term moves are unpredictable, so stay disciplined instead of reacting to them."]}
